MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 400

2. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 50
   C. 7
   D. 49

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 7
   C. 5
   D. 1

4. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 66
   B. 17
   C. 22
   D. 34

5. What is √81? (1 mark)
   A. 40.5
   B. 9
   C. 81
   D. 10

6. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 22
   C. 11
   D. 121

7. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 2/2
   B. 1/4
   C. They are equal
   D. Cannot tell

8. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 100 m²

9. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 42
   C. 30
   D. 90

10. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 90

11. Solve for x: x + 3 = 7. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 4
   C. 5
   D. 3

12. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15.6
   C. 15.7
   D. 15

13. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 24
   C. 42
   D. 36

14. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 56
   B. 1
   C. 57
   D. 15

15. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 12x + 2

16. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27
   C. 27.7
   D. 27.6

17. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.025
   B. 0.205
   C. 0.25
   D. 2.5

18. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31
   C. 31.7
   D. 31.6

19. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

20. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.6
   C. 29
   D. 23.7

21. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.7
   C. 19.6
   D. 19

22. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

23. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 11
   C. 24
   D. 5

24. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
